tool_args.rationale: The paid observations cover only H=0.16–0.48, far short of the target horizon. A slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the predicted endogenous reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-horizon model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short horizons do not identify the slow adaptation needed for a forecast near H=21.1.
The pilot does not vary s_grad and cannot distinguish this mechanism; the slow-horizon probe is recommended first.
Additional fine short-horizon measurements would not resolve the long-horizon ambiguity as directly.
The pilot and mechanism guidance favor adaptation, but the long-horizon probe is needed to discriminate the behavior.
